name: pixi
description: pixi — package management and task runner for conda/pypi ecosystems. Cross-platform, fast, reproducible environments.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/prefix-dev/pixi/releases/download/v0.68.0/pixi-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz && tar xzf pixi-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz && sudo mv pixi /usr/local/bin/ && rm pixi-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz

commands.description: pixi — package management and task runner for conda/pypi ecosystems. Cross-platform, fast, reproducible environments.
